description: Dynamically loads and executes a specified role as a task.

parameters.name: allow_duplicates
parameters.description: Overrides the role’s metadata setting to allow using a role more than once with the same parameters. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Accepts a hash of task keywords (for example tags, become) that will be applied to all tasks within the included role.

parameters.name: defaults_from
parameters.description: File to load from a role’s defaults/ directory. Default: "main"

parameters.name: handlers_from
parameters.description: File to load from a role’s handlers/ directory. Default: "main"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the role to be executed.

parameters.name: public
parameters.description: This option dictates whether the role’s vars and defaults are exposed to the play. If set to true the variables will be available to tasks following the include_role task. This functionality differs from standard variable exposure for roles listed under the roles header or ansible.builtin.import_role as they are exposed to the play at playbook parsing time, and available to earlier roles and tasks as well. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: rolespec_validate
parameters.description: Perform role argument spec validation if an argument spec is defined. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: tasks_from
parameters.description: File to load from a role’s tasks/ directory. Default: "main"

parameters.name: vars_from
parameters.description: File to load from a role’s vars/ directory. Default: "main"

examples:
- ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: myrole

- name: Run tasks/other.yaml instead of 'main'
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: myrole
    tasks_from: other

- name: Pass variables to role
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: myrole
  vars:
    rolevar1: value from task

- name: Use role in loop
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: '{{ roleinputvar }}'
  loop:
    - '{{ roleinput1 }}'
    - '{{ roleinput2 }}'
  loop_control:
    loop_var: roleinputvar

- name: Conditional role
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: myrole
  when: not idontwanttorun

- name: Apply tags to tasks within included file
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: install
    apply:
      tags:
        - install
  tags:
    - always
